name: Hivebound Captain
biography: Mellarium centurio. A honey-hued ooze commander wearing a rapier, leading swarms of insects with barked stance orders — aggressive when attacking, near-impenetrable when defending. Habitat: Forest.

features.name: Flyby
features.description: The captain doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

features.name: Hive Commander
features.description: At the start of each of the captain's turns, it chooses either Attack Stance or Defence Stance. In Attack Stance, it scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20. In Defence Stance, it has a +2 bonus to AC (AC 19).

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The captain makes two Stinging Rapier attacks.

features.name: Stinging Rapier
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Saving Throw: DC 15 Constitution, one creature hit by this attack. Failure: 14 (4d6) Poison damage, and the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Attack Order
features.description: The captain summons one Swarm of Insects in an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet. The swarm takes its turn immediately after the captain on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the captain. A swarm disappears after 1 minute, if it's reduced to 0 Hit Points, or if it's ever more than 300 feet away from the captain.

features.name: Defend Order
features.description: The captain sprays out a cloud of swarmlings in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the captain that lasts until the start of its next turn. When an enemy of the captain enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.
